representative_choice: 最小可运行代表为消息传递GNN；若torch_geometric不可用，预注册回退为纯PyTorch固定邻接图卷积，不切换到更大模型
baseline: verified M3/M4 PDE solver for accuracy and POD-ridge reduced-order surrogate for speed/complexity
target_defect: 大量重复工况调用M3/M4的时间成本；不主张修复物理真实性
new_mechanism: 在轴对称有限体积邻接图上学习一个时间推进算子，节点状态含T,C,xi,zeta和体积，边特征含距离、面面积与法向；全局条件含h,hm,经验式参数、边界历史编码和R(t)
operator: U^{n+1}=U^n+Delta_t*G_theta(U^n,E,p,b_n); boundary nodes receive encoded Robin data; Q4 volumes/R(t) are explicit inputs
rollout: teacher forcing only in training; validation/test always autoregressive to the threshold event
inputs: verified PDE trajectories on the unified scenarios
mesh graph and cylindrical control volumes
identifiability: network weights have no physical-parameter interpretation; only input-output sensitivity is reported. No causal or material-property claim is allowed
minimum_experiment_matrix: POD-ridge baseline and GNN on 18,36,72 training scenarios
Q3/Q4 interpolation and one-factor extrapolation splits
rollout horizons 3 h, 24 h and threshold horizon
ablations: remove volume/Jacobian features, remove boundary encoding, one-step versus autoregressive
timing at batch size 1 and 16 with break-even analysis
expected_evidence: sample-out field/event accuracy, drift with horizon, geometry-aware ablation, speed and model size
retention_threshold: use surrogate rule in 统一比较合同.json and additionally outperform POD-ridge in C-RMSE by >=10% without violating safety rules
fallback: if dependencies fail or GNN does not beat POD-ridge, retain POD-ridge as the only supplementary surrogate; if extrapolation fails, restrict to registered interpolation box
claim_limit: accuracy is relative to M3/M4 synthetic labels, not independent experimental truth
literature_transfer: P17/L18 directly motivates region-aware graph surrogates for porous-media drying but its dataset, architecture and performance do not transfer
P15/L05 supports mechanistic-simulation-generated learning data and hybrid role
